kits.title: Household & Cashflow Clarity
kits.audience: Families, renters, caretakers, and solo earners organizing bills, errands, and weekly savings without paid software.
kits.outcome: Turns scattered notes and calendar reminders into one calm offline floorplan with bill anchors, meal prep rhythm, and a rainy-day buffer.
kits.markdown:
# Household & Cashflow Clarity

Plain-English operating map for keeping home bills, groceries, and weekly family commitments calm on any basic laptop or phone.

## Wave 0: Baseline Snapshot
- [ ] List every fixed monthly bill with due date and autopay status [Wave 0]
- [ ] Write down actual take-home pay after taxes and deductions [Wave 0] (depends: List every fixed monthly bill)
- [ ] Mark one quiet 20-minute Sunday check-in slot on the fridge calendar [Wave 0]

## Wave 1: Weekly Rhythm & Groceries
- [ ] Group recurring errands into two neighborhood loops per week [Wave 1] (depends: Mark one quiet 20-minute Sunday check-in slot)
- [ ] Build a 10-meal rotating pantry list using ingredients already on hand [Wave 1] (depends: Write down actual take-home pay)
- [ ] Flag two sneaky subscriptions to pause or cancel this month [Wave 1] (depends: List every fixed monthly bill)

## Wave 2: Rainy-Day Buffer & Shared Handoff
- [ ] Move first $25 per paycheck into a separate no-card buffer jar or account [Wave 2] (depends: Flag two sneaky subscriptions)
- [ ] Export this floorplan as a single HTML file saved onto a shared family folder [Wave 2] (depends: Group recurring errands)

## Lexicon
- **Paycheck Anchor**: The exact amount left for food, fuel, and flexibility after fixed rent and utilities clear.
- **Zero-Spend Day**: A planned weekday with no card swipes, cooked from pantry staples.
- **Sunday Reset**: A 20-minute weekly glance at upcoming due dates and fridge inventory.
- **Buffer Floor**: One month of core rent and groceries kept separate from daily spending.

## Wiki
### Bill Calendar Rule
Split fixed bills into First-Half (days 1 to 14) and Second-Half (days 15 to 31) buckets so no single paycheck absorbs every utility at once.
### Fridge Inventory Habit
Before shopping, list three items that spoil fastest and pick two dinners built around them first.

## Soul
- Invariant: Plain numbers beat complex spreadsheets that nobody opens after week two.
- Invariant: Money plans exist to buy quiet evenings, not to create guilt over small coffees.
- Invariant: Everything stays readable offline without logins, bank links, or monthly fees.

kits.markdown:
# Local Service & Workshop Launch

Zero-budget operating kit for an everyday craftsperson or neighborhood service pro starting with referrals and a phone.

## Wave 0: Clear Offer & Boundaries
- [ ] Define one signature 90-minute job you can finish reliably every time [Wave 0]
- [ ] Set a transparent flat rate plus parts rule in plain English [Wave 0] (depends: Define one signature 90-minute job)
- [ ] List your exact service radius in driving minutes rather than vague zones [Wave 0]

## Wave 1: Customer Intake & Field Checklist
- [ ] Write a 4-question text intake script for photo, address, urgency, and access [Wave 1] (depends: Set a transparent flat rate)
- [ ] Pack a pre-departure tool checklist so no repeat hardware-store trips steal profit [Wave 1] (depends: Define one signature 90-minute job)
- [ ] Prepare a 3-sentence arrival and wrap-up message for neighbors [Wave 1] (depends: Write a 4-question text intake script)

## Wave 2: Referrals & Offline Proof
- [ ] Ask every delighted neighbor for one photo permission and one neighborhood intro [Wave 2] (depends: Prepare a 3-sentence arrival and wrap-up message)
- [ ] Export your portable quote and job tracker HTML onto your phone home screen [Wave 2] (depends: Pack a pre-departure tool checklist)

## Lexicon
- **Scope Lock**: Agreeing in writing on what is included and what triggers a fresh quote before tools leave the truck.
- **Drive Radius Cap**: Maximum minutes from home base so fuel and traffic never erase hourly margin.
- **Wrap Receipt**: A short plain-text summary sent after completion with before/after care tips.
- **Neighbor Card**: One offline referral note shared person-to-person instead of paying ad networks.

## Wiki
### Why Flat-Rate Diagnostics Win Trust
Homeowners fear open-ended hourly clocks. Naming a fixed inspection fee that credits toward the repair earns immediate calm.
### Repeat Maintenance Reminders
Log seasonal follow-ups (filters, gutters, tune-ups) at 6 months so existing customers keep your calendar full.

## Soul
- Invariant: Show up on time, leave the workspace cleaner than found, and explain options without jargon.
- Invariant: Zero paid ads until 10 local customers refer a neighbor organically.
- Invariant: Keep customer names and schedules under your own control, never locked inside a platform.

kits.title: 30-Day Creator & Newsletter System
kits.audience: First-time writers, teachers, makers, and independent builders sharing honest notes without chasing algorithms.
kits.outcome: Builds a repeatable weekly writing habit with a living topic map, personal voice anchor, and zero-loss 25-turn AI handoff capsule.
kits.markdown:
# 30-Day Creator & Newsletter System

Lightweight publishing floorplan for ordinary makers who want to write useful essays, guides, or dispatches in under 4 hours a week.

## Wave 0: Voice Anchor & Reader Promise
- [ ] Name the exact kind of neighbor or beginner you are writing to [Wave 0]
- [ ] Capture 5 real questions friends asked you in the last 30 days [Wave 0] (depends: Name the exact kind of neighbor)
- [ ] Write 3 tone rules describing how you talk in real life [Wave 0]

## Wave 1: Idea Map & Drafting Loop
- [ ] Turn one real question into a 3-step plain-English outline [Wave 1] (depends: Capture 5 real questions)
- [ ] Collect one real example, number, or photo from your own bench or notebook [Wave 1] (depends: Turn one real question into a 3-step plain-English outline)
- [ ] Draft messy first pass in 25 uninterrupted minutes before editing a word [Wave 1] (depends: Write 3 tone rules)

## Wave 2: Package, Ship & Rehydrate
- [ ] Strip buzzwords and verify zero inflated claims or filler intros [Wave 2] (depends: Draft messy first pass)
- [ ] Generate a 25-Turn Pass-Down capsule so next week's AI assistant remembers your voice [Wave 2] (depends: Strip buzzwords)

## Lexicon
- **Bench Note**: A short firsthand observation from doing real work rather than summarizing someone else's thread.
- **Voice Guardrail**: Three concrete words you use and three clichés you ban from every draft.
- **Pass-Down Capsule**: A compact plain-text digest preserving decisions and open threads before context fills up.
- **One-Click Keep**: Exporting your finished guide as a portable HTML kit readers can save offline.

## Wiki
### The 3-Beat Dispatch Structure
Start with a concrete friction you actually ran into, walk through the small fix step by step, and end with one printable action.
### Context Hygiene Across Sessions
Never paste 40 pages of old chat logs into a fresh AI session. Paste only your Soul rules, Lexicon, and current active outline.

## Soul
- Invariant: Write like a helpful neighbor across a kitchen table, never like a corporate press release.
- Invariant: Teach one real thing you tested yourself instead of repackaging hype.
- Invariant: Own your subscriber list and notes as plain files on your own drive.

kits.markdown:
# Community & Teaching Hub

Zero-install peer workshop blueprint so small local groups can learn together on donated Chromebooks, older laptops, or library Wi-Fi.

## Wave 0: Room Setup & Shared Vocabulary
- [ ] Define the plain-English starter glossary with zero unexplained acronyms [Wave 0]
- [ ] Pick one 45-minute hands-on project every attendee can finish in session one [Wave 0] (depends: Define the plain-English starter glossary)
- [ ] Test offline file sharing via USB drive or local HTML file before class [Wave 0]

## Wave 1: Peer Stations & Live Floorplan
- [ ] Pair beginners with returning helpers using 2-person buddy checklists [Wave 1] (depends: Pick one 45-minute hands-on project)
- [ ] Run a 15-minute live walkthrough converting a paper note into a visual mind-map [Wave 1] (depends: Test offline file sharing)
- [ ] Collect honest stuck-points in a shared friction log at the end of class [Wave 1] (depends: Pair beginners with returning helpers)

## Wave 2: Graduation & Viral Kit Pass-On
- [ ] Have every participant export their personal kit HTML to bring home [Wave 2] (depends: Run a 15-minute live walkthrough)
- [ ] Invite graduates to co-host Day 1 next month for two new neighbors [Wave 2] (depends: Have every participant export their personal kit HTML)

## Lexicon
- **USB-Ready**: Any guide or tool that opens directly in a browser without accounts, cloud billing, or npm installs.
- **Friction Log**: A list of exact moments beginners hesitated so week two gets clearer.
- **Buddy Checklist**: Two learners verifying each milestone together before moving on.
- **Pass-On Kit**: An exported offline studio file containing the attribution badge to invite the next cohort.

## Wiki
### Why Offline-First Matters in Local Workshops
Public rooms drop Wi-Fi right when 12 people click download. Single-file HTML kits keep the workshop flowing even in airplane mode.
### Measuring Real Learning
Skip attendance vanity metrics. Count how many attendees walk out holding a working plan they actually understand.

## Soul
- Invariant: Nobody gets left behind because they cannot afford a subscription or a newer laptop.
- Invariant: Curiosity thrives when learners can inspect, edit, and break their own notes safely.
- Invariant: Every free learner becomes a capable teacher for their own household or block.

weeks.title: Name Your World in Plain Words
weeks.summary: Dump the mental clutter, capture how you actually speak, define 10 personal terms, and lock in your everyday boundaries.
weeks.deliverable: Verified Voice Anchor & Personal Lexicon saved in your kit.

weeks.title: Turn Messy Notes Into Spatial Maps
weeks.summary: Break overwhelming goals into Wave 0, Wave 1, and Wave 2 dependencies you can see on one calm Floorplan screen.
weeks.deliverable: Interactive SVG Mind-Map & Dual-View Reader layout.

weeks.title: Run Repeat Work Without Losing Context
weeks.summary: Use the 25-Turn Pass-Down capsule and SHA-256 memory digest so free AI tools never forget your rules mid-project.
weeks.deliverable: Portable 25-Turn Rehydration Capsule & Weekly Sprint Loop.

weeks.title: Own Your System and Pass It On
weeks.summary: Export a self-contained single-file HTML WebOS studio you keep offline forever and share with friends at zero cost.
weeks.deliverable: Single-file Offline WebOS HTML Kit & Community Pass-On Note.

days.title: Empty the Kitchen-Table Brain Dump
days.prompt: Write 10 messy bullet points about the one weekly headache eating your peace right now. Do not polish grammar yet; just name bills, tasks, or unfinished promises.
days.deliverable: Raw 10-line plain-English note loaded inside the Refractory editor.

days.title: Write Three Soul Rules You Refuse to Break
days.prompt: List 3 plain rules for how your time and money must be treated (for example: no complex spreadsheets, protect Sunday evenings, zero hidden fees).
days.deliverable: 3 Soul invariants pinned under ## Soul.

days.title: Build Your First Five-Word Lexicon
days.prompt: Pick 5 words you and your household actually say and give each a crisp 1-sentence meaning under ## Lexicon so any assistant uses your real words.
days.deliverable: 5 defined plain-English terms visible in the Lexicon tab.

days.title: Separate Facts From Guesses
days.prompt: Tag every line in your Day 1 note as either a hard fact (a due date, rate, or address) or an open guess you still need to check.
days.deliverable: Verified Wave 0 facts list with guesses quarantined.

days.title: Ban Five Hollow Phrases From Your Voice
days.prompt: Write down 5 corporate or robotic phrases you never say out loud so you can strip them whenever drafting emails, quotes, or guides.
days.deliverable: Voice filter block saved in ## Soul.

days.title: Create One Pocket Wiki Entry
days.prompt: Write a 4-line how-to note under ## Wiki explaining one recurring chore or fix the way you would teach a younger cousin.
days.deliverable: First structured Wiki entry tested in Dual-View Reader.

days.title: Week 1 Review & Clean SHA-256 Snapshot
days.prompt: Open the 25-Turn Capsule tab, verify your first SHA-256 fingerprint, and save a clean Week 1 offline backup HTML file.
days.deliverable: Signed Week 1 offline HTML kit stored locally.

days.title: Split Today From Next Week (Wave 0 vs Wave 1)
days.prompt: Reorganize your headings into ## Wave 0 (must happen first) and ## Wave 1 (only starts after Wave 0 clears) and watch the Mind-Map draw two clear tiers.
days.deliverable: Two-wave Floorplan tree with zero tangled priorities.

days.title: Wire Explicit Task Dependencies
days.prompt: Add (depends: ...) tags to 4 tasks that truly wait on another step, then click nodes in the SVG Mind-Map to trace what unlocks what.
days.deliverable: Connected dependency edges in Floorplan view.

days.title: Turn a Scattered Offer Into a One-Page Scope
days.prompt: Load the Local Service & Workshop Launch kit and rewrite the Wave 0 offer lines to fit one actual service or skill you could offer neighbors.
days.deliverable: Clear 90-minute scope and transparent rate block.

days.title: Build a Four-Question Customer or Family Intake
days.prompt: Draft 4 short intake questions anyone can answer by text message in 60 seconds without downloading an app.
days.deliverable: Copy-ready 4-question text intake under ## Wiki.

days.title: Design Your Wave 2 Finish Line
days.prompt: Add a ## Wave 2 section naming what 'done for the week' looks like so work stops expanding endlessly.
days.deliverable: Three-wave Floorplan (Wave 0, Wave 1, Wave 2) rendered cleanly.

days.title: Audit Dual-View Readability at Arm's Length
days.prompt: Switch to Dual-View Reader and trim any sentence longer than 22 words until every step reads clearly on a phone screen.
days.deliverable: Trimmed Dual-View editorial guide under 3-minute reading time.

days.title: Map Hidden Failure Modes Into Checklists
days.prompt: Think of the last time a job or errand ran late, and turn the root cause into a single - [ ] pre-check item.
days.deliverable: Pre-departure failure-prevention checklist.

days.title: Week 2 Floorplan Lock & Visual Export
days.prompt: Inspect every node in your SVG Floorplan, verify dependencies make sense at a glance, and save your Week 2 HTML snapshot.
days.deliverable: Verified Week 2 Floorplan HTML archive.

days.title: Build Your First 25-Turn Pass-Down Capsule
days.prompt: Generate a compact Rehydration Capsule in Tab 4 and see how a 300-word brief carries your entire project into a fresh chat window.
days.deliverable: Compact Pass-Down Markdown brief with SHA-256 receipt.

days.title: Separate Durable Rules From Disposable Chatter
days.prompt: Move any permanent rule out of your daily scratchpad and into ## Soul or ## Lexicon so transient tasks never bloat your core prompt.
days.deliverable: Lean LOD-1 Soul + Lexicon layer under 400 words.

days.title: Run a 25-Minute Sprint Without Editing Mid-Flow
days.prompt: Pick one Wave 1 task from the Creator System kit and execute it straight through in 25 minutes using only your Pass-Down Capsule.
days.deliverable: One complete unpolished first draft or task outcome.

days.title: Test Hot-Swapping a Terminal Context Manifest
days.prompt: Inspect or edit a local synthesis JSON snapshot and use Reload Terminal Context / Import JSON to swap curated prompts without touching code.
days.deliverable: Verified JSON hot-swap roundtrip inside Refractory Tab 4.

days.title: Convert Repetition Into One Reusable Prompt Card
days.prompt: Identify one task you repeated 3 times this month and save its exact inputs, output shape, and voice constraints under ## Wiki.
days.deliverable: Zero-code repeatable workflow card in Wiki.

days.title: Verify Every Claim Against Real Observation
days.prompt: Review your draft or service guide and strike every unverified stat, replacing hype with one real example or honest boundary.
days.deliverable: Truth-checked draft with zero fabricated claims.

days.title: Practice Mid-Project Handoff Across Tools
days.prompt: Copy your 25-Turn Pass-Down Capsule into a completely blank notebook or fresh AI tab and confirm it resumes at the exact next task.
days.deliverable: Zero-drift cold-start handoff verification.

days.title: Week 3 Compaction Gate & Digest Audit
days.prompt: Prune finished Wave 0 and Wave 1 clutter into concise archived lessons, keeping only active Wave 2 tasks and core Soul rules.
days.deliverable: Compacted Sprint Markdown with updated SHA-256 stamp.

days.title: Package a Beginner-Safe Teaching Version
days.prompt: Load Community & Teaching Hub and simplify your own guide so a neighbor with zero technical background can follow Wave 0 in 10 minutes.
days.deliverable: Beginner-tested plain-English starter floorplan.

days.title: Run the Airplane-Mode Independence Test
days.prompt: Click Export My Kit (.html), turn off Wi-Fi or open the saved file directly from disk, and verify every heading, map node, and checklist still works.
days.deliverable: Verified offline single-file HTML WebOS bundle.

days.title: Write Your Honest One-Sentence Share Note
days.prompt: Use Copy Share Note to craft a 2-sentence explanation telling one friend what your personal kit actually solved this month.
days.deliverable: Authentic peer-to-peer share note ready for text or chat.

days.title: Host a 20-Minute Kitchen-Table Walkthrough
days.prompt: Walk one friend, partner, or coworker through your live Floorplan and record the single spot where they asked a clarifying question.
days.deliverable: Real-user friction note patched directly in ## Lexicon.

days.title: Create a Monthly Refresh Ritual
days.prompt: Schedule one 30-minute end-of-month calendar block to export a fresh archive and roll open Wave 2 tasks into next month's Wave 0.
days.deliverable: Sustainable monthly maintenance anchor.

days.title: Bundle Your Final 30-Day Capstone Kit
days.prompt: Combine your sharpest Soul rules, active Floorplan, Lexicon, and best Wiki notes into one clean master snapshot.
days.deliverable: Final Capstone WebOS HTML kit with verified digest.

days.title: Ship It Forward: Pass the Offline Kit
days.prompt: Send your exported HTML kit or Start Day 1: Free link to one person who feels buried in tabs and watch them map their first note in 5 minutes.
days.deliverable: Completed 30-Day Kit shipped and passed on at zero cost.
